brief.name: Continuity tester and open path
brief.purpose: Tester probes either side of a plainly separated copper path
brief.plannedMethod: Actual OpenAI base imagery with preserved original output; all exact labels/values in semantic UI, with manual diagrams/edits truthfully recorded

binding.alt: Two probes touch opposite sides of a copper conductor with a visible break between the frayed ends.
binding.caption: At the continuity pedestal, inspect each required conductor. The bench separately identifies the cracked section. An open reading alone does not locate a real-world break; the kit measures, and the replacement operation restores the section.

conversion: Scale the full uncropped frame with Lanczos and encode RGB WebP at quality 88, method 6. No retouching or labels in the derivative.
